examples.title: Converting Units
examples.explanation: Multiply the liter part by 1000 and add the remaining milliliters.

examples.title: Grocery Math
examples.problem: You bought 2 kg of sugar, 500 g of tea, and 750 g of dal. Total weight?
examples.explanation: Convert all to same unit (grams), add, and then convert back to kg and g.

examples.title: Capacity Comparison
examples.problem: Which holds more: a 1.5 l bottle or three 500 ml cups?
examples.solution: 3 x 500 ml = 1500 ml = 1.5 l. They are equal.
examples.explanation: Compare by bringing both amounts to the same unit.
